        """Guard the live replay manifest, not historical source-byte equality.

        The historical node name is retained to make the restoration explicit.

                if name.endswith(".__init__"):
                    name = name[:-9]
                modules[name] = path
        seen, pending = set(), ["m4c_motion_replay"]
        while pending:
            name = pending.pop()
